items.translation: 该类是否有对应的方法

items.translation: 对应的接口方法，如果未找到则使用原始方法。

items.source: Check if the given type represents a common "simple" value type: primitive or primitive wrapper, Enum, String or other CharSequence, Number, Date, Temporal, ZoneId, TimeZone, File, Path, URI, URL, InetAddress, Charset, Currency, Locale, UUID, Pattern, or Class.
items.translation: 检查给定类型是否表示常见的“简单”值类型：基本类型或其包装类、Enum、String 或其他 CharSequence、Number、Date、Temporal、 ZoneId、TimeZone、File、Path、URI、 URL、InetAddress、Charset、Currency、 Locale、UUID、Pattern 或 Class。

items.source: NOTE: In contrast to AopUtils.getMostSpecificMethod(Method, Class), this method does not resolve bridge methods automatically. Call BridgeMethodResolver.findBridgedMethod(Method) if bridge method resolution is desirable — for example, to obtain metadata from the original method definition.
items.translation: 注意：与AopUtils.getMostSpecificMethod(Method, Class)相反，此方法不会自动解析桥接方法。如果希望解析桥接方法（例如，从原始方法定义中获取元数据），请调用BridgeMethodResolver.findBridgedMethod(Method)。

items.source: Checks Method.isSynthetic() (for implementation methods) as well as the GroovyObject interface (for interface methods; on an implementation class, implementations of the GroovyObject methods will be marked as synthetic anyway). Note that, despite being synthetic, bridge methods (Method.isBridge()) are considered as user-level methods since they are eventually pointing to a user-declared generic method.
items.translation: 检查 `Method.isSynthetic()`（针对实现方法）以及`GroovyObject`接口（针对接口方法；在实现类上，`GroovyObject`方法的实现无论如何都会被标记为合成）。请注意，尽管是合成的，桥方法（`Method.isBridge()`）被视为用户级方法，因为它们最终指向用户声明的泛型方法。

items.source: This method recursively searches the class hierarchy and implemented interfaces for an equivalent method that is public, declared in a public type, and exported to spring-core.
items.translation: 此方法递归搜索类层次结构和已实现的接口，以查找一个等效的 `public` 方法，该方法声明在 `public` 类型中，并且已导出到 `spring-core`。

items.source: This is particularly useful for arriving at a public exported type on the Java Module System which allows the method to be invoked via reflection without an illegal access warning. This is also useful for invoking methods via a public API in bytecode — for example, for use with the Spring Expression Language (SpEL) compiler. For example, if a non-public class overrides toString(), this method will traverse up the type hierarchy to find the first public type that declares the method (if there is one). For toString(), it may traverse as far as Object.
items.translation: 这对于在 Java 模块系统中导出公共类型特别有用，从而允许通过反射调用该方法而不会引发非法访问警告。这对于通过公共 API 在字节码中调用方法也很有用——例如，用于 Spring 表达式语言 (SpEL) 编译器。例如，如果一个非公开类重写了 `toString()`，此方法将向上遍历类型层次结构以查找声明该方法的第一个公共类型（如果有的话）。对于 `toString()`，它可能会一直遍历到 `Object`。
同时也支持 JVM 内部的原生数组类名。 不支持原生数组的"[]"后缀表示法；此功能仅由forName(String, ClassLoader)支持。

items.source: Call this method if you intend to use the thread context ClassLoader in a scenario where you clearly prefer a non-null ClassLoader reference: for example, for class path resource loading (but not necessarily for Class.forName, which accepts a null ClassLoader reference as well).
items.translation: 如果打算在明确偏好非空 ClassLoader 引用（例如用于类路径资源加载，但不一定用于 `Class.forName`，因为它也接受 `null` ClassLoader 引用）的场景中使用线程上下文 ClassLoader，请调用此方法：

items.source: The Collection must contain Class elements only.
items.translation: Collection 必须仅包含 Class 元素。

items.source: Essentially translates NoSuchMethodException to IllegalStateException.
items.translation: 本质上将NoSuchMethodException转换为IllegalStateException。

items.source: NOTE: If Java security settings disallow reflective access — for example, calls to Class#getDeclaredMethods, etc. — this implementation will fall back to returning the originally provided method.
items.translation: 注意：如果 Java 安全设置禁止反射访问——例如调用Class#getDeclaredMethods等——此实现将回退为返回最初提供的方法。

items.source: If the supplied method is not public or is static, or if a publicly accessible equivalent method cannot be found, the supplied method will be returned, indicating that no such equivalent method exists. Consequently, callers of this method must manually validate the accessibility of the returned method if public access is a requirement.
items.translation: 如果提供的不是 public 方法，或者是 static 方法，或者找不到可公开访问的等效方法，则返回所提供的该方法，表明不存在此类等效方法。因此，调用此方法的调用者必须手动验证返回方法的可访问性（如果需要公开访问）。

items.source: This is effectively equivalent to the forName method with the same arguments, with the only difference being the exceptions thrown in case of class loading failure.
items.translation: 这实际上等同于使用相同参数的forName方法，唯一的区别在于类加载失败时抛出的异常。

items.source: This implementation builds a JDK proxy class for the given interfaces.
items.translation: 该实现为给定的接口构建一个 JDK 代理类。

items.source:
This method makes a best-effort attempt at determining this, based on
checks that work on modern, mainstream JVMs.
items.translation: 此方法基于在现代主流 JVM 上运行的检查，尽力尝试确定这一点。

items.source: Determine whether the given interface is a common Java language interface: Serializable, Externalizable, Closeable, AutoCloseable, Cloneable, Comparable - all of which can be ignored when looking for 'primary' user-level interfaces. Common characteristics: no service-level operations, no bean property methods, no default methods.
items.translation: 确定给定的接口是否为常见的 Java 语言接口： Serializable、Externalizable、Closeable、AutoCloseable、 Cloneable、Comparable——所有这些在查找“主要”用户级接口时均可忽略。共同特征：无服务级操作、无 Bean 属性方法、无默认方法。

items.source:
Return a path suitable for use with ClassLoader.getResource (also suitable for use with Class.getResource by prepending a slash ('/') to the return value). Built by taking the package of the specified class file, converting all dots ('.') to slashes ('/'), adding a trailing slash if necessary, and concatenating the specified resource name to this.
As such, this function may be used to build a path suitable for loading a resource file that is in the same package as a class file, although ClassPathResource is usually even more convenient.
items.translation:
返回一个适合与 `ClassLoader.getResource` 一起使用的路径（通过在返回值前添加斜杠 ('/')，该路径也适合与 `Class.getResource` 一起使用）。其构建方法为：获取指定类文件的包名，将所有点号 ('.') 转换为斜杠 ('/')，必要时添加尾随斜杠，然后将指定的资源名称与此连接。
因此，此函数可用于构建加载与类文件位于同一包中的资源文件的路径，尽管通常 `ClassPathResource` 更为方便。

items.source: Determine whether the Class identified by the supplied name is present and can be loaded. Will return false if either the class or one of its dependencies is not present or cannot be loaded.
items.translation: 确定由提供的名称标识的Class是否存在且可以加载。如果类或其任一依赖项不存在或无法加载，则返回false。

items.source: Delegate for BeanUtils.isSimpleValueType(Class).
items.translation: `BeanUtils.isSimpleValueType(Class)` 的委托。

items.source: Determine if the given type represents either Void or void.
items.translation: 确定给定类型是否表示 `Void` 或 `void`。

items.source: Given an input class object, return a string which consists of the class's package name as a pathname, i.e., all dots ('.') are replaced by slashes ('/'). Neither a leading nor trailing slash is added. The result could be concatenated with a slash and the name of a resource and fed directly to ClassLoader.getResource(). For it to be fed to Class.getResource instead, a leading slash would also have to be prepended to the returned value.
items.translation: 给定一个输入类对象，返回一个字符串，该字符串由类的包名作为路径名组成，即所有点 ('.') 均替换为斜杠 ('/')。不添加前导或尾随斜杠。结果可与斜杠及资源的名称拼接后直接传递给 ClassLoader.getResource()。若要将其传递给 Class.getResource，则还需在返回值的开头添加一个斜杠。

items.source: Suffix for array class names: "[]".
items.translation: 数组类名称的后缀："[]"。

items.source: The CGLIB class separator: "$$".
items.translation: CGLIB 类分隔符："$$"。

items.source: Determine the name of the package of the given class, for example, "java.lang" for the java.lang.String class.
items.translation: 确定给定类的包名，例如，对于 `java.lang.String` 类为 "java.lang"。

items.source: Determine the name of the package of the given fully-qualified class name, for example, "java.lang" for the java.lang.String class name.
items.translation: 确定给定完全限定类名的包名，例如，对于 `java.lang.String` 类名，其包名为 "java.lang"。

items.source: Replacement for Class.forName() that also returns Class instances for primitives (for example, "int") and array class names (for example, "String[]"). Furthermore, it is also capable of resolving nested class names in Java source style (for example, "java.lang.Thread.State" instead of "java.lang.Thread$State").
items.translation: `Class.forName()` 的替代方案，它也能返回基本类型（例如 "int"）和数组类名（例如 "String[]"）对应的 Class 实例。此外，它还支持以 Java 源代码风格解析嵌套类名（例如使用 "java.lang.Thread.State" 而不是 "java.lang.Thread$State"）。

items.source: Check if the given class represents a primitive (i.e. boolean, byte, char, short, int, long, float, or double), void, or a wrapper for those types (i.e. Boolean, Byte, Character, Short, Integer, Long, Float, Double, or Void).
items.translation: 检查给定类是否表示基本类型（即 boolean、byte、char、short、int、long、float 或 double）、void，或是这些类型的包装类（即 Boolean、Byte、Character、Short、Integer、Long、Float、Double 或 Void）。

items.source: Determine if the supplied class is an inner class, i.e. a non-static member of an enclosing class.
items.translation: 确定提供的类是否为内部类，即外部类的非静态成员。

items.source:
in favor of custom (possibly narrower) checks
such as for a Spring AOP proxy
items.translation: 有利于自定义（可能更窄）的检查，例如针对 Spring AOP 代理的检查。

items.source: The ".class" file suffix.
items.translation: ".class" 文件后缀。

items.source: Convert a "."-based fully qualified class name to a "/"-based resource path.
items.translation: 将基于"."的完全限定类名转换为基于"/"的资源路径。

items.source: Convert a "/"-based resource path to a "."-based fully qualified class name.
items.translation: 将基于"/"的资源路径转换为基于"."的完全限定类名。

items.source: Determine the common ancestor of the given classes, if any.
items.translation: 确定给定类的共同祖先（如果有）。

items.source:
Return all interfaces that the given instance implements as an array,
including ones implemented by superclasses.
items.translation: 返回给定实例实现的所有接口作为数组，包括由超类实现的接口。

items.source:
Return all interfaces that the given instance implements as a Set,
including ones implemented by superclasses.
items.translation: 返回给定实例作为 Set 实现的所有接口，包括由超类实现的接口。

items.source:
Return all interfaces that the given class implements as an array,
including ones implemented by superclasses.
items.translation: 返回给定类实现的所有接口作为数组，包括由超类实现的接口。

items.source:
Return all interfaces that the given class implements as a Set,
including ones implemented by superclasses.
items.translation: 返回给定类作为 Set 实现的所有接口，包括由超类实现的接口。

items.source:
Determine the name of the class file, relative to the containing
package: for example, "String.class".
items.translation: 确定类文件的名称，相对于其包含的包：例如，"String.class"。

items.source:
Return a descriptive name for the given object's type: usually simply
the class name, but component type class name + "[]" for arrays,
and an appended list of implemented interfaces for JDK proxies.
items.translation: 返回给定对象类型的描述性名称：通常仅为类名，但对于数组则为组件类型类名加"[]"，对于 JDK 代理则附加已实现的接口列表。

items.source:
Return the qualified name of the given class: usually simply
the class name, but component type class name + "[]" for arrays.
items.translation: 返回给定类的限定名称：通常为类名本身，但对于数组则为组件类型类名加"[]"。

items.source: Return a public static method of a class.
items.translation: 返回类的公共静态方法。

items.source:
Return the user-defined class for the given class: usually simply the given
class, but the original class in case of a CGLIB-generated subclass.
items.translation: 返回给定类的用户定义类：通常为给定的类本身，但在 CGLIB 生成的子类情况下为原始类。

items.source:
Return the user-defined class for the given instance: usually simply
the class of the given instance, but the original class in case of a
CGLIB-generated subclass.
items.translation: 返回给定实例的用户定义类：通常为给定实例的类，但在 CGLIB 生成的子类情况下为原始类。

items.source:
Does the given class or one of its superclasses at least have one or more
methods with the supplied name (with any argument types)?
Includes non-public methods.
items.translation: 给定的类或其任一父类是否至少包含一个或多个具有指定名称（无论参数类型如何）的方法？包括非公共方法。

items.source: Determine if the supplied class is a static class.
items.translation: 判断提供的类是否为静态类。

items.source: Check whether the given class is visible in the given ClassLoader.
items.translation: 检查给定类在给定 ClassLoader 中是否可见。

items.source: Check whether the given class matches the user-specified type name.
items.translation: 检查给定类是否与用户指定的类型名称匹配。

items.source:
Resolve the given class if it is a primitive class,
returning the corresponding primitive wrapper type instead.
items.translation: 如果给定类是基本类型，则解析该基本类型，并返回相应的基本类型包装器。

items.source:
Override the thread context ClassLoader with the environment's bean ClassLoader
if necessary, i.e. if the bean ClassLoader is not equivalent to the thread
context ClassLoader already.
items.translation: 如有必要，请使用环境中的 bean ClassLoader 覆盖线程上下文 ClassLoader，即当 bean ClassLoader 与现有的线程上下文 ClassLoader 不等价时。

items.source:
Check whether the given class is cache-safe in the given context,
i.e. whether it is loaded by the given ClassLoader or a parent of it.
items.translation: 检查给定类在给定上下文中是否缓存安全，即该类的加载器是否为给定的 ClassLoader 或其父加载器。

items.source:
Check if the given class represents a primitive wrapper,
i.e. Boolean, Byte, Character, Short, Integer, Long, Float, Double, or
Void.
items.translation: 检查给定类是否为基本包装类，即 Boolean、Byte、Character、Short、Integer、Long、Float、Double 或 Void。

items.source:
Check if the given class represents an array of primitives,
i.e. boolean, byte, char, short, int, long, float, or double.
items.translation: 检查给定类是否表示基本类型的数组，即 boolean、byte、char、short、int、long、float 或 double。

items.source:
Check if the given class represents an array of primitive wrappers,
i.e. Boolean, Byte, Character, Short, Integer, Long, Float, or Double.
items.translation: 检查给定类是否表示基本类型的包装器数组，即 Boolean、Byte、Character、Short、Integer、Long、Float 或 Double。

items.source:
Check if the right-hand side type may be assigned to the left-hand side
type, assuming setting by reflection. Considers primitive wrapper
classes as assignable to the corresponding primitive types.
items.translation: 检查右侧类型是否可以通过反射赋值给左侧类型。将原始包装类视为可赋值给对应的原始类型。

items.source:
Determine if the given type is assignable from the given value,
assuming setting by reflection. Considers primitive wrapper classes
as assignable to the corresponding primitive types.
items.translation: 确定给定类型是否可以从给定值赋值，假设通过反射进行设置。将原始包装类视为可赋值给对应的原始类型。

items.source: Check whether the specified class is a CGLIB-generated class.
items.translation: 检查指定的类是否为 CGLIB 生成的类。

items.source: Check whether the specified class name is a CGLIB-generated class.
items.translation: 检查指定的类名是否为 CGLIB 生成的类。

items.source:
Return the short string name of a Java class in uncapitalized JavaBeans
property format. Strips the outer class name in case of a nested class.
items.translation: 返回未大写的 JavaBeans 属性格式的 Java 类短字符串名称。如果是嵌套类，则剥离外层类名。

items.source:
Return the number of methods with a given name (with any argument types),
for the given class and/or its superclasses. Includes non-public methods.
items.translation: 返回给定类及其父类中具有指定名称（任意参数类型）的方法数量。包括非公共方法。

items.source: classLoader - the ClassLoader to check against (can be null in which case this method will always return true)
items.translation: classLoader - 要检查的 ClassLoader（可以为 null，在这种情况下该方法将始终返回 true）

items.source: true if the type represents Void or void
items.translation: true 如果该类型表示 Void 或 void

items.source: true if rhsType is assignable to lhsType
items.translation: 如果 rhsType 可赋值给 lhsType，则为 true

items.source: ClassNotFoundException - if the class was not found
items.translation: ClassNotFoundException - 如果未找到该类的情况

items.source: LinkageError - if the class file could not be loaded
items.translation: LinkageError - 如果无法加载类文件

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if the class name was not resolvable (that is, the class could not be found or the class file could not be loaded)
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果类名无法解析（即找不到该类或无法加载类文件）

items.source: IllegalStateException - if the corresponding class is resolvable but there was a readability mismatch in the inheritance hierarchy of the class (typically a missing dependency declaration in a Java Module System module definition for a superclass or interface implemented by the class to be loaded here)
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果对应的类可解析，但在该类的继承层次结构中出现了可读性不匹配（通常是因为在要加载的此类所实现的超类或接口的 Java 模块系统模块定义中缺少依赖声明）。

items.source: classLoader - the class loader to use (can be null which indicates the default class loader)
items.translation: classLoader - 要使用的类加载器（可以是 null，表示使用默认类加载器）

items.source: IllegalStateException - if the corresponding class is resolvable but there was a readability mismatch in the inheritance hierarchy of the class (typically a missing dependency declaration in a Java Module System module definition for a superclass or interface implemented by the class to be checked here)
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果对应的类可解析，但在该类的继承层次结构中出现了可读性不匹配（通常是因为在要检查的类的 Java 模块系统模块定义中缺少对超类或接口的依赖声明，而该类实现了这些超类或接口）。

items.source: classLoader - the ClassLoader to potentially cache metadata in (can be null which indicates the system class loader)
items.translation: classLoader - 可能缓存元数据的类加载器（可以为 null，表示系统类加载器）
